name: command-binary-stdin-continuation-11
objective: Complete the maintained managed-command roadmap obligation for binary standard input. Add stdin: bytes | None = None to the existing immutable public Command specification, plus with_stdin(bytes) replacement and without_stdin() removal. None preserves current inherited-stdin behavior; configured bytes (including empty bytes) must be delivered exactly through a child pipe followed by EOF. Accept only immutable bytes or None at construction; invalid types must raise TypeError, including fluent replacements. Preserve command value/hash semantics and stdin through every existing fluent operation. Feed input while both output streams are drained so large input and a child that writes large output before reading cannot deadlock. Early child input closure/exit remains an ordinary CommandResult, not an unhandled pipe error. Existing timeout/cancellation cleanup must still bound blocked input and reap the immediate child. Preserve argv, cwd, output/event retention and result identity, without shell execution or parent-global mutation. Investigate the existing source and dependencies; do not change tests or acceptance. Independent behavior, original regressions, Ruff, formatting and strict typing are mandatory.
oracle:
import asyncio, hashlib, inspect, sys
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from devtools.core.paths import ResolvedPath
from devtools.core.time import Duration
from devtools.resources.commands import Command, CommandExecutor, CommandTimeoutError

def model_checks(cls):
    assert "stdin" in inspect.signature(cls).parameters, "Command must support optional binary stdin"
    command = cls(sys.executable, stdin=b"payload\x00\xff")
    assert command.stdin == b"payload\x00\xff"
    assert cls(sys.executable).stdin is None
    assert command == cls(sys.executable, stdin=b"payload\x00\xff")
    assert hash(command) == hash(cls(sys.executable, stdin=b"payload\x00\xff"))
    assert command != cls(sys.executable, stdin=b"other")
    assert hasattr(command,"with_stdin") and hasattr(command,"without_stdin"), "Expose immutable stdin replacement/removal"
    assert command.with_stdin(b"").stdin == b""
    assert command.without_stdin().stdin is None
    for transformed in (command.args("-V"),command.with_args("-V"),command.without_args(),command.with_executable(sys.executable),command.cwd(ResolvedPath(Path.cwd())),command.without_cwd(),command.with_timeout(Duration.seconds(2)),command.without_timeout()):
        assert transformed.stdin == command.stdin
    for invalid in ("text",bytearray(b"mutable"),1,False,memoryview(b"view")):
        try:cls(sys.executable,stdin=invalid)
        except TypeError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError("Only immutable bytes or None may be configured as stdin")
        try:command.with_stdin(invalid)
        except TypeError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError("Fluent stdin replacement must enforce byte validation")
    try:setattr(command,"stdin",b"changed")
    except FrozenInstanceError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError("Command must remain frozen")

async def execution_checks(cls, executor_cls):
    with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        path=ResolvedPath(Path(directory))
        echo="import sys; data=sys.stdin.buffer.read(); sys.stdout.buffer.write(data); sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'err')"
        for data in (b"",b"\x00\xffa\r\nb\n",b"abc"*100000):
            command=cls(sys.executable,("-c",echo),working_directory=path,timeout=Duration.seconds(8),stdin=data)
            result=await executor_cls().execute(command)
            assert result.succeeded and result.stdout==data and result.stderr==b"err", "Child stdin must receive exact bytes and EOF without disturbing output capture"
            assert result.command is command
        # Child writes both streams beyond pipe capacity before reading stdin.
        # Serial write-before-drain implementations deadlock here.
        payload=b"input"*50000
        script="import sys,hashlib; sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'o'*200000); sys.stdout.buffer.flush(); sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'e'*200000); sys.stderr.buffer.flush(); data=sys.stdin.buffer.read(); print(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())"
        result=await executor_cls().execute(cls(sys.executable,("-c",script),timeout=Duration.seconds(8),stdin=payload))
        assert result.succeeded and result.stdout[:200000] == b"o"*200000 and result.stdout[200000:].splitlines() == [hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest().encode()] and result.stderr==b"e"*200000, "Input feeding and both output drains must make concurrent progress"
        # Exiting without consuming input is a normal command result, not a
        # broken-pipe exception escaping the managed lifecycle.
        result=await executor_cls().execute(cls(sys.executable,("-c","import sys;sys.exit(7)"),timeout=Duration.seconds(8),stdin=b"x"*300000))
        assert result.exit_code == 7, "Early input closure must preserve ordinary exit status"
        try:
            await executor_cls().execute(cls(sys.executable,("-c","import time;time.sleep(5)"),timeout=Duration.seconds(0.1),stdin=b"x"*300000))
        except CommandTimeoutError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError("Timeout must also bound blocked input feeding and clean up the child")
        # Independent concurrent byte streams must not be interleaved.
        results=await asyncio.gather(*(executor_cls().execute(cls(sys.executable,("-c",echo),timeout=Duration.seconds(8),stdin=d)) for d in (b"first",b"second")))
        assert [r.stdout for r in results]==[b"first",b"second"]

def run_checks(cls=Command,executor_cls=CommandExecutor):
    model_checks(cls)
    asyncio.run(execution_checks(cls,executor_cls))
    print("PASS: immutable binary stdin, fluent/validation compatibility, exact empty/binary/large input, concurrent pipe pressure, early exit, timeout and isolated executions")

if __name__=="__main__":run_checks()
